description_en: Call this operation to restart a lightweight database instance in the Running state
description_zh: 如果轻量数据库实例处于运行状态，您可以通过此接口重启轻量数据库实例
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open restart-database-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-instance-id db-38263fa955774501a2ae1bdaed6f0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RestartDatabaseInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the lightweight database instance. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html to get the latest list of supported Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the lightweight database instance
parameters.name: database_instance_id

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token to ensure request idempotency. The token must be unique for each request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
